[[Team Rocket airship]] }} (Japanese: '''トロピウス、漂う''' ''Tropius, Float'') is the 613th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 18th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Riding on {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}'s back, {{adv|Ruby}} is relieved to see {{adv|Sapphire}}, standing unharmed on [[Troppy]]. Sapphire tries to yell out to him, but Ruby realizes that she lost her voice after learning the truth about the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]]. He apologizes to her, and she takes out a {{DL|Decoration|Generation VI decorations|blackboard}}. Using a piece of chalk, she writes to Ruby that wants to help save the world. She then warns him to never leave her behind again. Meteorites begin to fall from the sky, and Ruby urges Sapphire to put Troppy into its [[Poké Ball]] and jump onto Rayquaza's back. After Rayquaza grabs a meteorite in its jaws, Ruby holds out his hand toward Sapphire. As another meteorite approaches, Sapphire leaps from Troppy onto Rayquaza's back, without taking Ruby's hand. By tapping his chest with her finger, she communicates that she is eager to stop the meteor. Smiling, the two begin to practice using {{m|Dragon Ascent}}. As [[Aarune]] and {{adv|Wally}} watch Ruby and Sapphire fly away on Rayquaza, Aarune is reminded of a {{DL|Tao trio|Myths|myth}} from [[Unova]] about a hero teaming up with a {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon. Suddenly, a blast is heard coming out of Wally's [[Secret Base]]. Wally and Aarune stare in shock as {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} emerge from the cave. In the sky, {{adv|Emerald}}, {{p|Diancie}}, and {{p|Hoopa}} ride on {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} and {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias}} as they rush to find Kyogre and Groudon. They head toward [[Fortree City]], where Latios and Latias are able to detect a unique type of energy being released. [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]], revealed to be standing on top of Kyogre and Groudon, command the Pokémon to use {{m|Origin Pulse}} and {{m|Precipice Blades}} against Rayquaza. To their confusion, neither their Pokémon nor Rayquaza attacks. Everyone realizes that it is because a large meteorite is charging down at them from above. Archie and Maxie command their Pokémon to attack the meteorite, yelling at Ruby to get out of their way. Understanding that Archie and Maxie share the same goals as himself and Sapphire, Ruby cooperates and prepares to attack from a different angle. Rayquaza, Kyogre, and Groudon use Dragon Ascent, Origin Pulse, and Precipice Blades, respectively. In an unknown room, {{adv|Red}} finds himself being woken up by {{adv|Green}}. He is shocked to find {{adv|Amber}} and [[Blaise]] standing across from them. All four of them realize that they have been rescued after being attacked by Kyogre and Groudon, but all of their Pokémon and belongings are missing. Red begins to recognize where they are—the [[Team Rocket airship]]. Confirming his theory, {{adv|Giovanni}} enters the room. Red yells at him, demanding back his Pokémon, but Giovanni reveals that he had only stored them away so Red wouldn't attack him. Giovanni explains that like Red and the others, he only wants to save the world from destruction. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} apologizes to {{adv|Sapphire}}. * Sapphire agrees to help Ruby ride with {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}. * {{adv|Emerald}}, [[Maxie]], and [[Archie]] arrive at {{rt|120|Hoenn}}. * {{p|Hoopa}} is left injured due to Maxie and Archie forcing their way through its ring. * Ruby, Sapphire, Maxie, and Archie combine the powers of Rayquaza, {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}, and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} to attack incoming meteoroids. * {{adv|Red}} wakes up on the [[Team Rocket airship]], where he meets with {{adv|Green}}, [[Blaise]], and {{adv|Amber}}. * {{adv|Giovanni}} appears and reveals he came to help destroy the meteoroid. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * {{adv|Wally}} * [[Maxie]] * [[Archie]] * [[Blaise]] * {{adv|Amber}} * [[Aarune]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Tropius}} ([[Troppy]]/{{tt|Pilo|Chuang Yi}};
